verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships a first-party GrowthBook Proxy that runs next to your app, caches SDK payloads, and keeps serving flags if the API is down. It also adds streaming and remote evaluation, and edge evaluation on Cloudflare Workers removes the network request to the GrowthBook API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the proxy's failover behavior, explicit documentation that SDK traffic is confined to a private network (only implied by running the proxy next to the app).

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network

citations.quote: Run the GrowthBook Proxy next to your app to cache SDK payloads, reduce latency, and keep serving flags if the API is down.
It turbocharges your GrowthBook implementation by providing speed, scalability, security, and real-time feature rollouts.
**Remote Evaluation** - Hide your features' business logic in insecure environments
This eliminates the network request to the GrowthBook API, unlocking blazingly fast edge-side and client-side SDK performance.
